svg.text: Data source for live numbers: scripted fixture engine driving the real built app (not a real engine, values illustrative). Position: 1 H8, 2 I9, 3 I7, 4 G7, 5 H6 selected. 4. G7 is an alternate to 4. G9 (fork after 3. I7), and G9 H9 J8 is the other line.
